title: Slack (send messages)
description: Sends a flow's message to a Slack channel through a Slack app's bot token: a message.send connector, the last step of a flow that runs on its own. Text only.
setup_notes: Create a Slack app at api.slack.com/apps, add the chat:write scope under OAuth & Permissions, install it to your workspace and copy the Bot User OAuth Token (it starts xoxb-). Invite the app to the channel (/invite @your-app). The channel id is in the channel's details, at the bottom. The credential lands disabled: enable it under API Credentials. The connector lands unapproved: approve it in Admin > Extensions > Connectors and run Test on its row, which posts a short test message. Then use it as a flow's message.send step.

questions.name: bot_token
questions.label: Bot User OAuth Token
questions.help: Starts xoxb-. Stored in the credential's secret store, never in the connector.

questions.name: name
questions.label: Connector name
questions.help: Lowercase letters, digits, dashes and underscores; a flow's step names it.

questions.label: Channel id
questions.help: Where messages go unless a flow's step says otherwise (its to input), e.g. C0123456789.
